session_note: Georgia's 2025-2026 Regular Session (General Assembly session ID 1033, a single two-year term) adjourned sine die on Legislative Day 40, 2026-04-02, confirmed via the legislature's own session-calendar data (legis.ga.gov API sessions/days/1033, which lists day 40 as 2026-04-02 with no further legislative days scheduled); a subsequent 2026 Special Session (ID 1034, June 17-23, 2026) covered redistricting and commendation resolutions only, with no data-center-related legislation. A bill that had not passed both chambers by 2026-04-02 dies for the full biennium (Georgia does not carry bills into a third year); bills that stalled in year one (2025) could still be acted on in year two (2026), as SB 34 shows, but nothing below moved after the dates recorded.
